newsitem.title: USA: Maidenform says it will pursue other opportunities.
newsitem.headline: Maidenform says it will pursue other opportunities.

text.p: Maidenform Worldwide Inc on Thursday said it would pursue other opportunities to ensure the privately held company's long-term success now that talks with VF Corp have ended.

"We intend to resume immediately previous discussions concerning other opportunities for the company. I am confident in the potential of the Maidenform business and look forward to new discussions to help secure our long-term success," Chairman Elizabeth Coleman said in a statement made available by the company.
Maidenform and VF, maker of the Vanity Fair and Vassarette brands of women's lingerie, earlier announced they had canceled merger talks. The companies declined to say why the discussions failed.
Earlier this year, Maidenform, the largest U.S. maker of women's intimate apparel, said it would explore long-term options for the company.
